description: §19.16.2 — an inner block's deferred body runs when the INNER block exits (before the outer block's), and a `defer` control never reached registers nothing. step(1): inner; mid; late registered; end; exit runs late then outer. step(9): the early `return` leaves before `defer late` executes, so only outer runs. trace = "body;inner;mid;end;late;outer;|body;inner;mid;outer;".
rationale: §19.16.2: Registration is against the innermost enclosing block (the `if` branch for `inner`); Not reached, not registered (the `late` defer after the early return in step(9)); Order: inner blocks' deferred bodies run when the inner block exits, and within a block LIFO (late before outer).
